keywords.def: belief in the heart, said with the tongue, shown in actions
modesty and shyness from doing wrong
voluntary charity, money or good deeds
sincerity: doing things for Allah alone

questions.q: Turn this into a 'character action': 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his neighbour.'
questions.a: For example: take a plate of food to our neighbour, or help carry their shopping.

questions.q: Moving a stone from the road is ...

Unit quiz (Teams Forms, 10 questions): 1) Fasting begins at? 2) Does eating by mistake break the fast? 3) Who makes up missed fasts? 4) Messengers named in the Qur'an? 5) Seal of the Prophets? 6) Message of all messengers? 7) Barzakh? 8) 99:7-8 teaches? 9) Four parts of qadar? 10) Camel hadith teaches?
questions.a: 1) Dawn (fajr) 2) No 3) The ill and travellers (qada') 4) 25 5) Muhammad ﷺ 6) Worship Allah alone 7) The life of the grave 8) Every good and bad deed will be seen 9) Knowledge, writing, will, creation 10) Make effort and trust Allah

questions.q: Extend: write your Ramadan character goal and three steps to reach it in the portal response box.
questions.a: For example: speak only good; step 1 count my unkind words, step 2 say 'I'm fasting' when angry, step 3 make du'a.

questions.q: Stretch: explain how sawm and good character are linked.
questions.a: Fasting trains self-control; the Prophet ﷺ said Allah has no need of the fast of someone who does not leave false speech (Bukhari).

questions.q: Which action shows the link between iman and character best?
options: Speaking kindly to a new pupil
questions.a: A) Speaking kindly to a new pupil. Good speech and kindness are signs of iman in the hadith. Showing off and selfishness are not.

questions.q: Which of these is a branch of iman?
Think again: how could someone tell you have iman?
questions.a: From my character: honesty, kindness, good speech, helping others.
